description: This file defines the EventHubBatchContainer class which implements IBatchContainer. It encapsulates a batch of EventData from Azure EventHubs, including payload, request context, and sequence tokens. It provides methods to access events, import request context, and serialize event data for streaming.

classes.name: EventHubBatchContainer
classes.description: Handles batching of EventHub EventData with serialization and request context integration for Orleans streaming.

classes.name: EventHubBatchContainer.Body
classes.description: Internal class representing the payload with events and request context.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves and casts events from the batch to a specific type, associating each with a sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports request context data into Orleans context if available.

methods.name: ToEventData
methods.description: Serializes events and context into an EventData object for sending.

methods.name: UpdateEventData
methods.description: Updates an EventData object with event payload and stream namespace.

methods.name: CreateEventDataBody
methods.description: Creates a BinaryData payload from events and request context.
